content: Multan mein aaj 47 degree! Hussain Agahi bazaar mein teen log behosh ho gaye. Ambulance bhi 20 minute mein nahi aayi. Yeh garmi qatal kar degi. #MultanHeatwave
Civil Hospital Multan mein heatstroke cases ki line lagi hai. 21 patients aayi hain subah se. Doctors bol rahe hain aaj worst day of the year. Bichon ko ghar par hi rakho.
Vehari Chowk ke paas underpass mein daraar aa gayi hai! Bari gaadi andar phans gayi. Zameen dhal rahi hai, traffic band kar do foran. #MultanRoads
Vehari Road underpass crack sari ghabrahat ki baat nahi — sirf ek truck neeche tha. Traffic abi bhi jaa raha hai slowly. Exaggeration mat karo.

PDMA South Punjab — Multan: Heatwave emergency declared. PMD confirms 47.2°C — 4th highest ever recorded in Multan. Civil Hospital reports 21 heatstroke cases by noon, 3 critical. WAPDA load-shedding schedule suspended to keep ACs running.

NHA Multan Inspector: Vehari Chowk underpass — structural crack 8m long, 3cm wide confirmed in approach slab. Likely heat expansion + subbase erosion. One HGV truck stuck. Load limit exceeded. Road closed to all traffic pending engineering inspection.
Vehari Road near Chowk — full closure. Speed 0km/h (normal 60km/h). NHA inspection team blocking all lanes. Alternate via Bosan Road.
Rescue 1122 Multan dispatch log: 31 heatstroke-related calls between 10:00-12:00. 8 confirmed collapses in public spaces. Hussain Agahi and Ghanta Ghar areas most affected.
Multan: 47.2°C, humidity 12%, wind 3km/h. Life-threatening heat emergency. Heat index exceeds 54°C. No relief expected until evening.
